catalog.purpose: Matched entry-only target-to-cost refinement of 24 frozen strict scalp benchmarks
catalog.scope: Eight instruments, three independently ranked lanes, unchanged 24 training-frozen unqualified benchmarks; no new base strategy/risk/target search
catalog.threshold_definition: Allow entry when the intended gross target value divided by modeled round-trip spread, adverse slippage and commission is >= threshold; zero disables the filter
catalog.quote_formula: reward * stop_distance / (spread + 2 * slippage + 2 * commission_usd_per_unit_side * (intended_target_bid if USD-base else 1))
catalog.information_boundary: Closed signal ATR and modeled entry-open bid, fixed known cost assumptions, direction and intended bracket; no realized exit, excursion, return or future bar
catalog.usd_base_conversion: Intended target is an entry-known order level. Both target gross P/L and price friction convert at that level; dollar commissions remain dollars. No realized exit is used in the filter.
catalog.execution: A rejected signal gets a nonfinite stop distance and is skipped by the unchanged kernel. Preserve every signal row, session counter, hold cap, blackout, and cost; re-simulate the complete path.
catalog.risk_and_holding: Inherit each frozen benchmark exactly: $1000 per account, 0.25% risk, 5-minute closed signals, 5/10/15-minute maximum holds; no target widening to pass the filter
catalog.cost_policy: All original spreads, slippage, fees, margin and minimum sizes stay unchanged. Recompute eligibility at each stressed cost; zero fills are not a robust profit.

selection.rank: Use the frozen scalp selection function: eligible first, both base-cost training years with at least 25 trades second, then highest worst training account net across years/costs, then base training count. Prefer earlier catalog threshold on a tie.
selection.fallback: Unqualified diagnostic choice only; no promotion when no threshold passes training
selection.chronology: Write a training-only selection freeze before any new 2024 replay; all 2024 threshold results are descriptive comparisons, never grounds for reselection

catalog.qualification: Positive net expectancy, PF > 1.5, DD < 10%, at least 200 distinct completed out-of-sample trades, stressed-cost and stability passes, no timing/data/margin failure. Previously reused 2024 cannot provide fresh qualification.
catalog.parity: All 288 threshold-zero accounts must match the prior frozen training/2024 metrics, audits and trade-ledger hashes exactly

limitations: Known 2023 incomplete session windows are excluded
Retrospectively retrieved calendars are not point-in-time archives
Fixed conservative modeled costs; no full-period tick execution proof
No volume or manipulation intent inferred from OHLC
Independent account totals are not a shared-capital portfolio
A margin-maintenance breach invalidates a path; no invented broker fill
Limited to 24 previously frozen scalp benchmarks; not a new full-grid search
Intended target-to-cost does not predict hitting that target within 15 minutes
Skipped signals and position paths differ under filters and stressed sizing
format_note: Compact public checkpoint. Full per-account entry-filter/audit details and simulated ledgers are in the private evidence package; this summary retains complete metrics and ledger hashes.
